item.title: Speeding cars, 13th July
item.description:
At the T junction. And along Pittville Crescent Lane, used as a cut through. Speeding cars along a single lane road ( which is actually a two way traffic road) speed controls are desperately needed. There is going to be a fatal accident as road used by cyclists. Children and many special needs people on motorised transport. You must sort this out. Any injury or death will be because you have not taken reasonable precautions . Making this a one way, with speed humps, is desperately needed.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 3, Pittville Crescent Lane, Lynworth, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet
